sequential_dependency.intermediate: The traced sequence, its maximal equal-color runs, and the length k of its first run.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Follow the unique four-neighbor colored path from its row-major smaller endpoint, producing its ordered color sequence.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use k as a one-based address among subsequent runs; recolor exactly that run to 9, not every occurrence of its color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: B needs the order and run boundaries recovered from the winding route. Spatial row-major scanning changes the header or addressed run even though the same colored cells are present.
